tag: A Soxhlet Apparatus is a laboratory tool used for the continuous solid-liquid extraction of compounds. It is ideal when the desired target molecule has a limited solubility in a solvent, and the impurity or solid matrix is insoluble. It automatically recycles a small amount of heated solvent to wash the solid sample repeatedly over hours.
